verdict.rationale: Independent community benchmarking says Ghostty handles heavy output well, with throughput when catting a large file in the same league as Alacritty (ghostty-comm-8), and users describe it as feeling fast on Linux (ghostty-comm-9). However, nothing in the pack documents GPU-accelerated rendering; the docs only say libghostty provides rendering capabilities (ghostty-docs-36). Responsiveness is also mixed: one hands-on report found higher input lag than xfce4-terminal (ghostty-comm-1), and an older benchmark ranked its input latency worst, though a newer one shows about 13ms (ghostty-comm-7). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of GPU-accelerated rendering, consistent evidence of low input latency under load, and first-party performance claims or benchmarks.
